relationships.subject: AOAH
relationships.evidence_quote: We recently showed that AOAH mediates CNS arachidonic acid homeostasis at the level of sequestration in phospholipids, leading to elevated PGE2 signaling that contributes to pelvic pain [59].

key_findings: Microglial ablation with PLX5622 reduced pelvic allodynia in AOAH-deficient mice, and repopulation restored it.
AOAH-deficient mice show activated microglia morphology in prefrontal cortex and PVN, elevated serum endotoxin, and stronger BV2 activation by their stool.
